limitations: Synthetic, author-labeled corpus; no independent expert validation.
Recall is measured per playbook rule, not every possible legal issue.
Exact quotations verify provenance, not interpretation or completeness.
Provider failures count as missed expected rules; they are not discarded.

findings.title: Automatic Renewal Cancellation Deadline Exceeds 60 Days
findings.quote: The agreement rolls over into another annual term unless Vale delivers notice of non-renewal at least sixty-one days before expiry.
findings.rationale: The clause requires a notice of non-renewal at least sixty-one days before expiry, which exceeds the acceptable limit of 60 days.
findings.proposed_language: The agreement rolls over into another annual term unless Vale delivers notice of non-renewal at least sixty days before expiry.

findings.title: Data deletion period exceeds 30 days
findings.quote: After the contract ends, Alder Archive must erase all customer files within 31 days.
findings.rationale: The requirement to erase customer files within 31 days deviates from the preference of requiring deletion within 30 days.
findings.proposed_language: Alder Archive must erase all customer files within 30 days after the contract ends.

findings.title: Refund of unused prepaid fees not provided
findings.quote: all prepaid fees are non-refundable even for services not delivered.
findings.rationale: The clause states that all prepaid fees are non-refundable, which deviates from the requirement to refund unused prepaid fees upon termination for convenience.
findings.proposed_language: All prepaid fees shall be refunded for any unused services upon termination for convenience.

findings.title: Liability cap exceeds preferred duration
findings.quote: Each party's total liability is capped at the fees paid over the preceding twenty-four months; neither party is liable for indirect or consequential damages.
findings.rationale: The liability cap is based on fees paid over the preceding twenty-four months, which exceeds the preferred duration of twelve months.
findings.proposed_language: Each party's total liability is capped at the fees paid over the preceding twelve months; neither party is liable for indirect or consequential damages.

findings.title: Non-compliant renewal cancellation deadline
findings.quote: Non-renewal: either party must provide written notice at least 59 days before renewal.
findings.rationale: The requirement for written notice is 59 days, which exceeds the acceptable limit of 60 days or fewer for non-renewal notice.
findings.proposed_language: Either party must provide written notice at least 60 days before renewal.
